title: A tempo change mid-bar
description: Bar 1 carries two tempo marks: quarter = 120 with no location (the bar's start, as every mark was drawn before) and quarter = 60 located at the half-bar, over the third beat. Bar 2's only mark is located at the second beat (half = 90), so a bar's first tempo need not sit at its start. Every mark draws (core-measure-attributes-gaps.md, item 9; the census found only the first was), each its own run above the staff, clearing whatever it sits over.
